purpose: Independent real-plant outcomes, distinct from synthetic logic tests. Empty until actual independently adjudicated reference cases exist.

outcome_policy.notes: Define watering-needed at a stated time/horizon with a supported care endpoint. A single moisture percentage, compliance with an app reminder, or absence of a disease report is not automatically ground truth. Reference measurements are collected by the research team or opt-in cohort, not required of ordinary users.

evaluation_rules: Use only adjudicated cases under a predefined criterion; missing outcomes stay unevaluated.
Freeze model predictions before revealing reference labels. Never feed reference sensors or later weather into the ordinary-input prediction.
Split by grower/plant and future season; keep related hourly records in the same partition.
Report total case count and decision coverage, false watering, missed due decisions, and abstentions separately.
Report performance on decided cases alongside positive cases left uncertain; never silently count unknown as not_due or hide abstentions.
For disease outcomes, require confirmation/follow-up and a defined horizon; ambient context is not a positive diagnosis.
Zero eligible cases means not_evaluated, never100percent accuracy.
